comment.comment: # ... - a comment line, ignored by the runner
comment.name: comment.line.number-sign.tift-test

section.comment: --- [sandbox] [label] - ends the current test and restarts, optionally into an empty sandbox room

command.comment: $ <command words> - a normal game command, matched by word display value

devcommand.comment: > <command words> - a developer/debug command, matched against debug-tagged words only

directive.comment: @item <id> - a setup directive, eg staging an item into the current location

negative.comment: ! <text> - fails if <text> appears anywhere in the output since the last command

assertion.comment: any other non-blank line - fails unless <text> appears in the output since the last command
assertion.name: string.unquoted.assertion.tift-test
